svg.text: K6 Loose ware and fast washer
Nothing that touches food is fixed: GN trays, stem tools and cassettes, one gantry with one grip, two 3.5-min wash wells.
wall width 2595 mm (2.6 m) · 600 deep · 2000 high
dry box: X rail, purge air, electronics
rear wall: spouts, anchor pins, cameras
2/8 Tray by its tang: wash at the sink
3/8 Pour into the press tube; tray into W1
4/8 Swing press slices into plate A
5/8 Plate A to the hob: frying
7/8 Plate A into W1; W1 washes
W1 open: wet parking for soiled ware · W2 washing the previous load
W1 washing (pre-spray, 60 °C wash, 85 °C rinse) · W2 open
W1 drying, lid ajar: clean ware back to store · W2 open
Every tray, pot, tool and cassette part carries the same tang 6 × 32 × 60 mm: one chuck,
no tool changer. 93 loose items; 40–55 used per full menu; 0 m² fixed food-contact surface.
1/8 Box docks and tilts: potatoes into the perforated GN 1/3 tray on the S0 scale (1.2 kg)
2/8 Chuck grips the tray by its tang and washes the potatoes under the spout (peeling on the fork not shown)
3/8 Tray tipped over its far rim into the press tube; the empty tray is hung straight into wash well W1
4/8 Swing press pulls down 3 kN; the chuck strokes the cut-off slide: 5 mm slices fall into thermoplate A
5/8 Chuck carries thermoplate A by its tang to hob column 1: frying (bridge over two coils)
6/8 Pair flip: preheated plate B laid on rim to rim, both tangs gripped, inverted, set down on column 2
7/8 Empty plate A hung in W1; W1 lid closes and washes; W2 opens as the next wet parking place
8/8 Food handed over in plate B; W1: 60 °C wash, 85 °C rinse, 3.5 min; steel dries by its own heat
